newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Genoa to report March CPI on March 20.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Genoa to report March CPI on March 20.

text.p: The Italian city of Genoa will publish its preliminary data of March consumer price index (CPI) inflation on March 20 at around 1630 GMT, said sources at the city's authority.
Of the other eleven Italian cities that report preliminary CPI data, Milan has also said it will report on March 20.

For February, Genoa registered a month-on-month fall of 0.3 percent and a 1.3 percent rise on a year-on-year basis. This was set against a 0.1 percent monthly rise and a 2.4 percent increase nationally in February.
The CPI data from Genoa has a weighting of 2.9 percent on the national index, while the official March CPI data for the whole of Italy will be published on April 7.
